title: Idolatrous
summary: IDOL'ATROUS, adjective Pertaining to idolatry; partaking of the nature of idolatry, or of the worship of false gods; consisting in the worship of idols; as idolatrous worship. 1. Consisting in or part

inlines.v: IDOL'ATROUS, adjective Pertaining to idolatry; partaking of the nature of idolatry, or of the worship of false gods; consisting in the worship of idols; as idolatrous worship. 1. Consisting in or partaking of an excessive attachment or reverence; as an idolatrous veneration for antiquity.
